The condition detected is actinic keratosis. Actinic keratosis is a skin condition that occurs due to prolonged exposure to ultraviolet (UV) light, usually from the sun. It typically appears as rough, scaly patches on sun-exposed skin, such as the face, ears, neck, scalp, and backs of the hands. These lesions can vary in color, from skin-toned to red or brown, and may be small in size.
